definitions.full: H1608. Gaash [ גַּ֫עַשׁ ] proper name, of a location הַרגָּֿ֑עַשׁ Josh 24:30 ; Judg 2:9 mountain in Ephraim, south of (חֶרֶסׅ תִּמְנַתסֶֿרַח q. v.; גָּ֑עַשׁ נַחֲלֵי 2Sam 23:30 = 1Chr 11:32 of ravines thereon, or near by.
